name: Co-op Translator 0.23.2
body:
## Highlights

- Fixed translation failures caused by valid inline-code placeholder reordering in languages such as Simplified Chinese.
- The validator now permits reordering only within the same plain-text line when the exact placeholder multiset is preserved.
- Markdown structure safeguards remain strict for tables, links, emphasis, math, grouping, code blocks, and cross-line movement.
- Diagnostics now identify the first unsafe source line and protected token, making failures easier to trace.

This fixes the production `zh-CN` `CHANGELOG.md` case without relying on progressively smaller chunks or switching models.

## Dependency updates

- Pillow 12.3.0 → 13.0.0
- MCP 1.29.1 → 1.30.0
- multidict 6.7.1 → 6.9.1

## What's Changed

- Core: Allow safe inline-code placeholder reordering by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/572
- Build(deps): Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/571
- Build(deps): Bump multidict from 6.7.1 to 6.9.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/565
- Build(deps): Bump mcp from 1.29.1 to 1.30.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/569
- Build: Bump version to 0.23.2 by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/574

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.23.1...v0.23.2
